extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: three-door off-road 4x4, approx. 4.6 x 2.0 x 2.4 m (L x W x H incl. roof rack and spare wheel), wheel diameter 0.80 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the rear door 'off-road-4x4_rear_door' carries the spare wheel and is a separate object with its origin on the hinge (right rear edge, rotate around local Z to open); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, seats, rear bench and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
